title: C14 models
description: Catalog row c14-models 1.0.0: the C14 models artifact (buckets, the 2024 and 2016 shock tables, shapes, NMD caps, multipliers, replicating portfolios, parameter-change flags).

c14Label.description: A non-empty bilingual label (an empty string is not a label).

c14Sign.description: Sign convention, stated in the document: a positive delta EVE or delta NII is a loss (SRP31.129; dossier 01 H.4).

c14Units.description: Units of every number: money in the stated scale of its currency, rates as decimals discounted continuously (SRP31.129), shocks in basis points, bucket midpoints in years, dates ISO.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

c14ShockSize.description: The shock sizes applied to a currency, in basis points. A tabled size is exactly the table's (SRP31.90 Table 2, d368 Annex 2 Table 1, RAN 21-13 Annex 1 Hoja 9); a currency without an entry in the BCBS table (CLP is in neither) passes only labelled as a Contraste estimate with its method, never as a regulatory parameter (dossier 01 H.3), and a tabled currency cannot be relabelled as an estimate.

weight.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

c14Tranche.description: A rolling tranche of the replicating portfolio and its weight.

items.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

c14Window.description: The weights re-estimated on one estimation window, in the order of the tranches (stability across windows).

c14DepositBeta.description: Deposit beta (pass-through of the market rate to the client rate), asymmetric in the direction of the move.

c14NmdModel.description: The static replicating portfolio of one NMD category at one valuation date (dossier 05 D.3). The weighted average maturity of a rolling tranche of maturity m is m / 2 (BCBS 368 footnote 38). A margin volatility the fit lacks is null with its reason.

bucket.description: Bucket of the 19 of SRP31.96 Table 3, 1 (overnight) to 19 (over 20 years).

midpoint_years.description: Bucket midpoint in years: one of the 19 of SRP31.96 Table 3.

c14BucketDef.description: One of the 19 time buckets of SRP31.96 Table 3.

core_share_cap.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

c14NmdCap.description: SRP31 Table 4 cap of a category.

c14Gamma.description: SRP31.119 Table 5 prepayment multiplier of a shock.

c14UMult.description: SRP31.125 Table 6 term-deposit early redemption multiplier of a shock.

c14Multipliers.description: The scenario multipliers of the prepayment rate and the term-deposit redemption rate, in the order of the six shocks.

c14NmdCaps.description: The three SRP31 Table 4 caps, exactly the table's.

c14Bank.description: The bank of the case (real FDIC aggregates, synthetic behaviour: SDD section 5).

c14ShockTable.description: A BCBS shock-size table transcribed as data, the 21 currencies in table order.

c14ShockShape.description: The six shock shapes of SRP31.91 to SRP31.92 with x = 4.

c14ParamChange.description: A change of a behavioural parameter between two valuation dates; flagged when it changed in a window that holds a limit breach (dossier 05 D.7: the SVB lesson).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

c14Fit.description: C14 models: the 19 buckets, the 2024 and 2016 shock tables as data, the shock shapes, the NMD caps and multipliers, the replicating portfolios with their stability across windows, the deposit betas and the parameter-change flags.
